movelist.name: Flail
movelist.effect: For each Injury the user has, Flail’s Damage Base is increased by +1.

movelist.name: Supersonic
movelist.effect: The target becomes Confused. On miss, the target suffers a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls for one full round.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Tail Whip
movelist.effect: All legal targets have their Defense lowered by 1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.effect: The Move is turned into a 1-Target Move and is re-directed at the user without fail, and cannot miss. This negates Lock-On or Mind Reader.  The user’s Special Attack is then raised by +1 Combat Stage.

abilities.name: Dry Skin
abilities.effect: Whenever the user is hit by a damaging Fire- Type Move or ends their turn in Sunny Weather, they lose a Tick of Hit Points. The user is immune to the damage and effects of Water-Type Moves, and whenever the user is hit by a damaging Water-Type Move or ends their turn in Rainy Weather, they gain a Tick of Hit Points.
